about_the_game:
TOLOM: Demo

This demo offers a first taste of TOLOM, a turn-based deckbuilding roguelike set in a mysterious world ruled by miasma.

What’s included in this demo:

  • First area of the game: Explore the opening region of the map and uncover its secrets.

  • One playable suit (character): Begin your journey with the Feline Suit, a balanced build focused on agility and smart attacks.

  • Core combat system: Experience strategic, turn-based battles where every card is consumed when used.

  • Starter deck and early progression: Use a variety of cards, acquire new ones through shops, and build your strategy.

  • Final boss of the area: Reach the end of the demo by facing the first major boss battle.

Please note:
This demo only includes a limited portion of the full game. Additional suits, regions, cards, enemies, and game mechanics are available in the full version.

Languages available: English
Game mode: Single player

Key Features:

  • Deckbuilding with fully consumable cards

  • Strategic and challenging turn-based combat

  • Suits that define your playstyle from the beginning

  • Open exploration and non-linear progression

  • High replayability with meaningful choices and varied paths

short_description: TOLOM is a deckbuilding roguelike with turn-based combat. Equip suits that change your playstyle, fight with consumable cards, and explore at your own pace. Choose your battles, find upgrades, and decide when to face the final challenge. If you fall, come back with a new strategy.
